tasks.label: kg-restart-and-reset-product-last-sync
tasks.command:
$conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { $procId = ($conn | Select-Object -First 1).OwningProcess; try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('STOPPED_PID=' + $procId) } catch { Write-Output ('STOP_FAILED_PID=' + $procId + ' ' + $_.Exception.Message) } } else { Write-Output 'NO_8000_LISTENER' }; Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Projects\KINGGAMES\START_MAIN_MANAGER.bat'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
db = r'C:\Projects\KINGGAMES\king_games_product_manager\products.db'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
c = conn.cursor()
c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(products)")
cols = [r[1].lower() for r in c.fetchall()]
if 'last_sync_at' not in cols:
    c.execute("ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN last_sync_at TEXT")
c.execute("UPDATE products SET last_sync_at = NULL")
conn.commit()
c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE last_sync_at IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(last_sync_at) != ''")
print('SYNCED_AFTER_RESET=', c.fetchone()[0])
conn.close()
PY
; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/dashboard/stats' -Method Get | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); $reader.ReadToEnd() } else { $_.Exception.Message } }
